dedupe_keys.name: alternative automobiles and diffusion and infrastructure aladin

description: Alternative Automobiles and Diffusion and Infrastructure (ALADIN) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research (ISI). The ALADIN model is an agent-based simulation of alternative fuel vehicles purchase decision. It uses driving data from several thousand individual vehicles. The core of the model is to calculate the total cost of ownership for different drivetrains (e. g. Coverage: China, Germany, India. Methodical focus: vehicle market diffusion, agent-based modeling. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: national states, NUTS 3. Software: Python 3. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
